findings.passage: House Bill 958 is absolutely full of ways to make it harder to vote.
findings.note: Campaign-site Instagram feed post (the date is the feed timestamp). She describes House Bill 958 as an election-law bill with early voting cuts, easier vote challenges, voter registration hurdles and less campaign finance transparency, notes the governor vetoed it, and asks supporters to press to uphold the veto. The post does not mention voter ID.
